1	// Package trail provides types and helpers for managing trail metadata.
2	// Trails are branch-centric work tracking abstractions stored on the
3	// entire/trails/v1 orphan branch. They answer "why/what" (human intent)
4	// while checkpoints answer "how/when" (machine snapshots).
5	package trail
6	
7	import (
8		"crypto/rand"
9		"encoding/hex"
10		"fmt"
11		"regexp"
12		"strings"
13		"time"
14	)
15	
16	const idLength = 6 // 6 bytes = 12 hex chars
17	
18	// ID is a 12-character hex identifier for trails.
19	type ID string
20	
21	// EmptyID represents an unset or invalid trail ID.
22	const EmptyID ID = ""
23	
24	// idRegex validates the format: exactly 12 lowercase hex characters.
25	var idRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{12}$`)
26	
27	// GenerateID creates a new random 12-character hex trail ID.
28	func GenerateID() (ID, error) {
29		bytes := make([]byte, idLength)
30		if _, err := rand.Read(bytes); err != nil {
31			return EmptyID, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate random trail ID: %w", err)
32		}
33		return ID(hex.EncodeToString(bytes)), nil
34	}
35	
36	// ValidateID checks if a string is a valid trail ID format.
37	func ValidateID(s string) error {
38		if !idRegex.MatchString(s) {
39			return fmt.Errorf("invalid trail ID %q: must be 12 lowercase hex characters", s)
40		}
41		return nil
42	}
43	
44	// String returns the trail ID as a string.
45	func (id ID) String() string {
46		return string(id)
47	}
48	
49	// IsEmpty returns true if the trail ID is empty or unset.
50	func (id ID) IsEmpty() bool {
51		return id == EmptyID
52	}
53	
54	// Path returns the sharded storage path for this trail ID.
55	// Uses first 2 characters as shard (256 buckets), remaining as folder name.
56	// Example: "a3b2c4d5e6f7" -> "a3/b2c4d5e6f7"
57	func (id ID) Path() string {
58		if len(id) < 3 {
59			return string(id)
60		}
61		return string(id[:2]) + "/" + string(id[2:])
62	}
63	
64	// ShardParts returns the shard prefix and suffix separately.
65	// Example: "a3b2c4d5e6f7" -> ("a3", "b2c4d5e6f7")
66	func (id ID) ShardParts() (shard, suffix string) {
67		if len(id) < 3 {
68			return string(id), ""
69		}
70		return string(id[:2]), string(id[2:])
71	}
72	
73	// Status represents the lifecycle status of a trail.
74	type Status string
75	
76	const (
77		StatusDraft      Status = "draft"
78		StatusOpen       Status = "open"
79		StatusInProgress Status = "in_progress"
80		StatusInReview   Status = "in_review"
81		StatusMerged     Status = "merged"
82		StatusClosed     Status = "closed"
83	)
84	
85	// ValidStatuses returns all valid trail statuses in lifecycle order.
86	func ValidStatuses() []Status {
87		return []Status{
88			StatusDraft,
89			StatusOpen,
90			StatusInProgress,
91			StatusInReview,
92			StatusMerged,
93			StatusClosed,
94		}
95	}
96	
97	// IsValid returns true if the status is a recognized trail status.
98	func (s Status) IsValid() bool {
99		for _, vs := range ValidStatuses() {
100			if s == vs {
101				return true
102			}
103		}
104		return false
105	}
106

108	type Priority string

111		PriorityUrgent Priority = "urgent"
112		PriorityHigh   Priority = "high"
113		PriorityMedium Priority = "medium"

125		TypeDocs     Type = "docs"

129	// ReviewerStatus represents the review status for a reviewer.

131	
132	const (

135		ReviewerChangesRequested ReviewerStatus = "changes_requested"

161	}

171		Author     string         `json:"author"`
172		Body       string         `json:"body"`

185		CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
186	}

188	// commonBranchPrefixes are stripped from branch names when humanizing.
189	var commonBranchPrefixes = []string{
190		"feature/",
191		"fix/",
192		"bugfix/",
193		"chore/",
194		"hotfix/",
195		"release/",
196	}
197	
198	// CheckpointRef links a checkpoint to a trail.
199	type CheckpointRef struct {
200		CheckpointID string    `json:"checkpoint_id"`
201		CommitSHA    string    `json:"commit_sha"`
202		CreatedAt    time.Time `json:"created_at"`
203		Summary      *string   `json:"summary"`
204	}
205	
206	// Checkpoints holds the list of checkpoint references for a trail.
207	type Checkpoints struct {
208		Checkpoints []CheckpointRef `json:"checkpoints"`
209	}
210	
211	// HumanizeBranchName converts a branch name into a human-readable title.
212	// It strips common prefixes (feature/, fix/, etc.), replaces dashes/underscores
213	// with spaces, and capitalizes the first word.
214	func HumanizeBranchName(branch string) string {
215		name := branch
216		for _, prefix := range commonBranchPrefixes {
217			if strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
218				name = strings.TrimPrefix(name, prefix)
219				break
220			}
221		}
222	
223		// Replace - and _ with spaces
224		name = strings.NewReplacer("-", " ", "_", " ").Replace(name)
225	
226		// Trim spaces and capitalize first letter
227		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
228		if name == "" {
229			return branch
230		}
231	
232		// Capitalize first character
233		return strings.ToUpper(name[:1]) + name[1:]
234	}
